title: Workshop on Comprehensive Access Program Guidelines at King Salman Center for Disability Research
summary: A workshop was held at the King Salman Center for Disability Research in Saudi Arabia to discuss the implementation of guidelines for the 'Comprehensive Access' program, aimed at improving accessibility and services for people with disabilities.
body:
A workshop was held at the King Salman Center for Disability Research in Saudi Arabia to discuss the implementation of guidelines for the 'Comprehensive Access' program, aimed at improving accessibility and services for people with disabilities.
